walkthroughs.body_html:
Areas of Inquiry: Music for Listening and Performance — a core area of Music.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Areas of Inquiry: Music for Listening and Performance brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Areas of Inquiry: Music for Listening and Performance.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
